279910213.description:
Mixed Brands
Smoking Pipe Collection with Carousel Rack and Humidor Jar
Vintage, Mixed Materials including Briar, Metal, and Glass
This comprehensive tobacco enthusiast's lot includes seven varied smoking pipes and a classic wooden carousel-style storage rack. The collection showcases a diverse range of pipe-making traditions, from the industrial aesthetic of the metal-stemmed Viking pipe to rustic, hand-carved artisan pieces and a highly detailed figural bowl featuring a carved bearded head. The centerpiece is a tiered wooden carousel that holds up to 12 pipes and features a central glass humidor jar for tobacco preservation.
Viking Metal Stem Pipe: Features a chrome-finished cooling stem and a removable bowl for cleaning
Figural Carved Pipe: Intricately detailed bowl depicting a bearded man, likely meerschaum or high-density composite
Hand-Carved Artisan Pipes: Two rustic faceted wood pipes, one bearing the hand-carved initials "RKB" on the underside
Wooden Carousel Rack: Two-tier walnut-toned wood construction with a ribbed glass humidor jar and matching wooden lid
Dimensions: Carousel rack measures approximately 7" in diameter and 6.5" in height to the lid top
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall. All pipes show evidence of previous use with carbon buildup inside the bowls and light tooth chatter or oxidation on some stems. The wooden carousel shows minor surface scuffing and finish wear consistent with age. The glass humidor jar is free of chips or cracks. The Viking metal stem shows light surface pitting typical of vintage chrome-plated components.

Description

Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.

279780734.description:
Polished Orthoceras Fossil Specimen with Multiple Cephalopods in Stone Matrix
This polished Orthoceras fossil specimen features multiple elongated fossilized cephalopods embedded in a black and gray stone matrix. The fossils display long cylindrical shapes with white to light gray chamber patterns, characteristic of this extinct marine animal from the Devonian period. The specimen has a partially polished surface with some raw areas, providing contrast and a natural appearance. It measures approximately 6 to 8 inches in height and is in good condition with minor chips consistent with natural stone fossils. Suitable for fossil collectors, educational displays, or decorative use.
